prompt: Locked-off studio shot, the camera does not move. The man in the yellow basketball jersey stands in a strict side profile facing right against a solid flat mid grey background, and holds that profile the whole time. He looks tough and dead serious, like an athlete staring down an opponent before the game: jaw set, steady level stare straight ahead toward the right side of the frame, almost completely still. Over the clip he shows small, slow changes of intensity while staying still: a slow clench of the jaw, his chin settling slightly, his eyes narrowing a little, one slow deep breath with the shoulders rising and falling slightly, a slight shift of weight. No head turn, he never turns toward the camera or away. He never looks up and never tilts his head back. No smiling. He does not talk, his mouth stays closed. No hand in frame. The light, the background and the jersey stay exactly the same throughout.
